Update 1:48 AM : On I-90 westbound just east of I-5 (MP 3) there is a collision blocking all lanes.  Medical Aid, Fire Assistance, the Incident Response Team, Tow Assistance, and the State Patrol have arrived on the scene.

Monday, Oct. 26, on most weeknights until Friday, Nov. 13 - The westbound SR 520 off-ramp to both northbound I-5 and East Roanoke Street will close for construction on most weeknights beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. The typical closure dates are Monday through Thursday evenings, though some nights could be canceled based on needs and/or holidays. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic that remains on the bridge past Montlake and Lake Washington boulevards will detour to southbound I-5.

Saturday, Nov. 7, nightly until the morning of Monday, Nov. 9 - The eastbound SR 520 off-ramp to Montlake Boulevard in Seattle will close for construction nightly beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. During this time, all traffic from I-5 that enters eastbound SR 520 will pay the SR 520 bridge toll. Those who do not want to pay the toll or who need access to Montlake from I-5 must use alternate routes.
